<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/carriers/{scac}/reinstatements"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Makes a `SUSPENDED` carrier `ACTIVE` again and clears the reason; it can book again. 409 `carrier-not-suspended` when it is not
suspended. Takes no body. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`; `If-Match` with the `ETag` is honoured (412 on mismatch). Publishes
`CarrierReinstated`.
